tracks.title: Open The Kingdom (Liquid Days, Part II)

verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, FM 39564, 1986).

notes.text:
Recorded and mixed at The Living Room, NY.
Additional recording at The Complex, LA.
Mastered at Masterdisk, NY. Produced for Euphorbia Productions, Ltd.

Two-sided 12" lyrics sheet inserted.
Catalog # also refers to US release.

Title of B1 as "Liquid Days (Part One)" on the back sleeve but as "Liquid Days (Part I)" on the disc label.
Title of B2 as "Open The Kingtom (Liquid Days, Part Two)" on the back sleeve but as "Open The Kingtom (Liquid Days, Part II)" on the disc label.
